base: Use case: style-transfer. Create ONE final NEUTRAL Options Joker card. Reference 1, the actual Balatro vanilla Joker, is the PRIMARY authority for CHARACTER DESIGN, simplified proportions, cartoon face and pixel-art language. Reference 2 provides ONLY red/blue choice composition, capsules, card border and subtle green code placement; DISCARD its ordinary man's face completely. The character must be a genuine grotesquely playful THEATRICAL HARLEQUIN / JESTER ICON in the style of reference 1, NOT a handsome human wearing a jester hat, NOT a portrait of a man, NOT an actor, not anime. An oversized flat porcelain-white clown MASK face, slightly angular round silhouette, exaggerated small red pointed clown nose, broad mischievous thin red painted grin, stylized cheek/temple shapes, no exposed natural skin, no realistic lips, no human jaw modeling. Narrow jet-black rectangular Matrix sunglasses across the mask. A striking two-point floppy jester hat, red on viewer-left and blue on viewer-right, gold bells. Bold red/blue diamond harlequin suit and angular ruff, a stylized small theatrical torso, short expressive arms with big simplified white cartoon gloves. Both gloved palms presented equally, viewer-left holding one clear RED capsule and viewer-right one clear BLUE capsule; equal size, equal emphasis. Charismatic, mysterious and playful, strongly reads as a Balatro Joker, not a person. TRUE coarse low-resolution pixel art designed on a 71x95 logical pixel grid: large flat clusters, minimal 2-tone shadows, chunky clean silhouettes, deliberately simplified facial shapes, no detailed finger anatomy, no smooth shading, no fine illustration. Off-white/WHITE neutral clean card paper and small gray stepped border, card fills71:95portraitcanvas. Background: restrained mint-green vertical fragmented code ONLY behind central head/shoulders, a few columns breaking into pale isolated pixels outward and fading completely well before white outer margins. No green or black rectangle, no digital wallpaper, preserve generous clean white paper. Pills and harlequin dominate. No lettering, no readable text, no JOKER/A/B labels, no watermark. Balanced red/blue neutral master sprite, not an active colored state.
a: Use case: precise-object-edit. Make the RED active A state of THIS EXACT approved Options HARLEQUIN. Strictly preserve the entire WHITE THEATRICAL MASK face, red diamond clown nose and red painted grin, gold face marks, black Matrix sunglasses, exaggerated jester identity, head placement/size, two-point hat silhouette, diamond-pattern costume, white card and gray stepped border, pixel grid and sparse mint-green vertical code fading out behind the center into white paper. No ordinary human face, no natural skin, no penguin. Change ONLY: both main hat points now RED, dominant red ruff and red accents while preserving some blue diamonds; the hand on VIEWER LEFT comes forward and a little higher with a clearly LARGER RED capsule, roughly 1.6x neutral size, with at most two tiny red glints. Viewer-RIGHT white glove recedes slightly with a smaller blue pill. Same face, same character, same camera, same composition; do not reimagine anything else. Crisp simple Balatro low-resolution pixel art readable at native71x95, no extra detail, no soft shading. Palette favors red clearly and instantly. Preserve ample clean white card margins and subtle central green digital fragments; no opaque colored background. One portrait card71:95 fillingcanvas, no lettering, no labels or watermark.
b: Use case: precise-object-edit. Make the BLUE active B state of THIS EXACT Options HARLEQUIN A sprite. Preserve its EXACT theatrical porcelain-white mask face, red diamond nose, red painted grin, gold face accents, black Matrix sunglasses, exaggerated jester identity, head position and size, hat silhouette, diamond costume pattern, gray stepped card border, white paper, coarse pixel grid and mint-green vertical code fragmenting into white behind the central head/shoulders. This is the SAME Joker switching mode, not a redesign. Change ONLY: BOTH large hat points BLUE; ruff BLUE and costume now predominantly BLUE with restrained red diamond accents. Swap hand emphasis WITHOUT mirroring the head or background: VIEWER-RIGHT white glove forward and slightly raised with a clearly LARGE BLUE capsule, matching the red pill prominence in input. VIEWER-LEFT glove now slightly receded with a SMALL red capsule, mirroring the arm depth relationship. Keep humanoid theatrical clown icon, no natural skin/ordinary man/animal. Simple bold Balatro pixel art designed to be readable at native71x95, same flat cluster shading, no extra detail. Background green remains subtle and centrally concentrated with lots of clean white paper at edges, no panel or wallpaper. No words, no A/B labels, no watermark. One portrait card71:95 fillscanvas.
